Ye puzzle interviews mein bahut poocha jaata hai... aur zyaadatar log ise galat solve karte hain! Kya aap kar paoge?
Raat ka time hai. Chaar dost ek pul paar karna chahte hain. Unke paas sirf ek torch hai, aur bina torch ke pul paar nahi ho sakta.
A ek minute leta hai, B do minute, C paanch minute, aur D aath minute. Pul par ek baar mein sirf do log ja sakte hain, aur saath chalein toh dheeme wale ki speed se.
Toh batao... kya chaaron pandrah minute mein pul paar kar sakte hain? Video ko paanch second rok ke socho, aur apna answer comment karo!
Zyaadatar log sochte hain, sabse tez A sabko chhod ke aaye. Lekin aath, ek, paanch, ek, do... satrah minute! Fail!
Sahi trick hai: dono slow logon ko ek saath bhejo! Pehle A aur B jaate hain, do minute. A torch leke wapas aata hai, ek minute.
Ab C aur D saath mein jaate hain, aath minute. B wapas aata hai, do minute. Aur aakhir mein A aur B phir se, do minute.
Do, plus ek, plus aath, plus do, plus do... theek pandrah minute! Aise hi puzzles ke liye, pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
